debate.key_bear_argument: Oversold extremes lack bullish confirmation (no RSI reversal, negative MACD, stalled Stochastic, ADX=13.91 no trend), weak fundamentals with zero insider conviction, earnings risk in 37 days, and macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, recession signals) make this a trap for mean-reversion traders.
